name: Audio
summary: Every sound in the game, all synthesised (no recordings): each engine family (cross- and flat-plane V8, V10, V12, flat-six, straight-six, V6, four) baked at many rpm bands by tools/engine_synth.py, with rev limiter, gearshift cuts and blips, pops and crackles, turbo, supercharger, hybrid and gearbox whines; tyre squeal, scrub, lock-up, road roar, kerbs, gravel, grass, wind and rain spray; Doppler for passing cars; crashes and contacts, start lights, menu clicks (short switch clicks, not beeps) and the intro screen's GT3 pass-by (Sound.passby()).
notes: Only listens: reads car state and race events, never changes the race. Engine loops, tyre and road loops and pops are WAVs in baked/, made by tools/engine_synth.py (python3 + numpy; rerun it after changing a family). The game crossfades the two baked rpm bands either side of the revs (see docs/AUDIO.md). A car picks its engine voice with engine.sound in its JSON ({family, turbo, supercharged, hybrid, gear_whine, limiter_hz, pops}) or it is worked out from cylinders and the description. Buses: Engine (engines, turbos, pops), Effects (tyres, road, crashes), UI. RaceAudio.set_environment(env) makes wet tracks hiss instead of squeal. Menu sounds live in menu_sounds.gd; a file in samples/ (same name, .wav or .ogg) replaces the synthesised one. Team radio: Sound.radio(text) reads a message out with the computer's text-to-speech voice (project setting audio/general/text_to_speech) between radio click/squelch sounds and over a static bed on the Radio bus (radio_open, radio_static, radio_close made in SoundBank); Sound.radio_stop(), Sound.radio_can_speak(). Settings: sound vol_radio, radio_voice.
